keyword_screen.method: All three PDF page rasters inspected alongside PyMuPDF font spans and coordinates. Actual39 title, subsection headings, Table39-1 title/rows, full-width Table39-2 title/headers/lexical row heads, upper-left Table39-3, Figure39-1 caption head and meaningful lexical heads inside every MinionPro-Bold clause screened. Table regular cells and figure captions are not falsely described as bold. Phrase/full-row aliases explicitly map to extracted headwords or broad partial families; wrap joins/case/plurals normalized. Not an every-body-word inventory, count target or clinical-coverage claim. Exclusions occur after lexical extraction.
